observations:
Torah #56 does not contain a cluster of 3 or more concepts with explicit bechina language that form an independent conceptual domain not covered by the 7 existing packages. The gap additions identified in torah_56_additions.json (14 proposed new edges) each belong naturally within the existing package structure:

- מר דרור, צופה, יום הביכורים → Package 2 (holy malkhut sub-concepts)
- מאסף ממון → Package 3 (evil malkhut attribute)
- תורה—מדות, בכל יום ויום, מנחה חדשה/תורה חדשה, מה → Package 5 (Torah/measures cluster)
- שבועות—חסד עליון, מקוה של שער החמשים—חסד עליון, עוגה—מצה, שבועות—עצרת → Package 1 (daat cluster elaborations)
- שמים—אש ומים, מקרא קדש—רוח הקדש → Package 4 (ruach/pulse/shamayim cluster)

The most significant structural gap in the dataset is the missing direct edge תורה — מדות (each is connected to adjacent nodes but the direct link is absent), which is the hub connection of Package 5.

Threshold check for new packages:
- Minimum required: 3 independent concepts with explicit bechina language forming a domain not covered by existing packages
- Largest independent cluster found in gap analysis: 2 nodes (חסד עליון appears as the bechina of both שבועות and מקוה של שער החמשים — but both שבועות and מקוה של שער החמשים are already in Package 1, so חסד עליון is merely an additional elaboration within that package, not a new independent domain)
- Threshold met: NO

threshold_check.notes: All gap-analysis additions are elaborations of or sub-components within the 7 existing packages. No independent cluster of 3+ new concepts with explicit bechina identity language was identified that would constitute a distinct new conceptual domain in Torah #56.
